{'translation': 'This week, Apple refreshed its lineup of third-party accessories, adding eight new products including the Aqara Thermostat Hub W200.'}

{'translation': 'Aqara first showcased the device back in January at CES 2026, before launching the Thermostat Hub W200 in April.'}

{'translation': "The Aqara Thermostat Hub W200 carries a $169.95 price tag at Apple. While that is $10 more than Amazon, if you have Apple Card credit to use up, or you're already doing some Apple shopping, it may be more convenient."}

{'translation': 'Apple offering it in both its online and physical stores is a strong endorsement. On top of that, it supports Apple Home-exclusive features like Apple Adaptive Temperature and Clean Energy Guidance.'}

{'translation': 'Apple also sells the more expensive ecobee Smart Thermostat Premium, which features built-in Siri and native HomeKit support rather than HomeKit over Matter.'}

{'translation': 'That said, the Aqara version still supporting Adaptive Temperature and Clean Energy Guidance through the Apple Home app makes it compelling.'}

{'translation': "This week's Apple Store product inventory update also added another Aqara smart home product: the Aqara Climate Sensor W100."}

{'translation': 'Along with those two Aqara smart home products, Apple is now also selling the following six accessories:'}

  • {'translation': 'Nimble Powerstack Charger / External Battery System'}
  • {'translation': 'Herschel Cloudform 14-inch MacBook Sleeve'}
  • {'translation': 'Herschel Cloudform 16-inch MacBook Sleeve'}
  • {'translation': 'Herschel Cloudform XL MacBook Backpack'}
  • {'translation': 'CalDigit Thunderbolt 5 (USB‑C) Pro Cable (2.0 m)'}
  • {'translation': 'Logitech Spotlight 2 Presentation Remote'}

{'translation': 'Next up, we\'ll be looking out for the iPhone Duo later this month, as well as the rumored display-equipped "HomePod" that\'s expected to make an appearance in October.'}

{'translation': 'Get the most out of your Apple devices'}
